# Debrief: Argo CD

These clips cover Argo CD in practice: an MCP server for AI-assisted operations, fast pull request diff previews, a GitOps adoption story with Rollouts, and an encoded-path gotcha when moving to Envoy Gateway. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [From FTP To Argo CD & Argo Rollouts: An Adoption History Inside a Corp · 12:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wrek7kjrcs0&t=737s); [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Argo CD diff preview renders pull requests with the real Argo CD in about 5 seconds across roughly 1,000 applications, using self-hosted runners and a namespace-scoped, slimmed-down Argo CD install. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
2. For Helm or Kustomize-templated setups, diff previews need custom work. Rendering only the applications and clusters affected by a change cut the render count from nearly 500, and plugins are supported. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 12:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=777s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
3. The Argo CD MCP server maps tools one-to-one to CLI and UI actions, including syncing applications and inspecting logs and live manifests. It is a very new project that is seeking feedback. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s))

## Action items

- [ ] Try Argo CD diff preview on pull requests, starting with a lockdown-mode, namespace-scoped Argo CD instance and self-hosted runners, and measure preview time against your own repository. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
- [ ] If you render Helm or Kustomize before Argo CD, plan to limit previews to the applications and clusters a change touches, and check whether your post-processing tools work as plugins. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 12:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=777s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
- [ ] Before any move to Envoy Gateway, test Argo CD paths that use encoded slashes, since normalization caused 404s for Argo CD and Vault until the escape setting was changed to keep paths unchanged. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Concrete 5-second PR previews and a locked-down Argo CD setup.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Shows how to narrow rendering scope and use plugins.
3. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s) (1:19), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Explains what the Argo CD MCP server can do today.
4. [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s) (2:27), Kalen Wessel: Warns about encoded-path 404s affecting Argo CD behind Envoy Gateway.
5. [From FTP To Argo CD & Argo Rollouts: An Adoption History Inside a Corp · 12:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wrek7kjrcs0&t=737s) (1:19), Alfonso Ming, Meritxell Rodríguez: Frames GitOps drift correction and Argo CD's role for newcomers.
